data.name: Hemraaj
data.gender_notes: Hemraaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hem means sun and Raaj means king. This name signifies the ruler of the sun and is a powerful and majestic name for a baby boy. The name Hemraaj carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Hemraaj usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hemraaj is a divine name that represents the supreme power of the sun god. It is believed that this name bestows the blessings of the sun god and brings prosperity, power, and wisdom to the child.
data.etymology: Hemraaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemraaj total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hemraaj holds a significant cultural impact in Hindu tradition. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Surya' (Sun) and 'Raja' (King), symbolizing the one who rules over the sun and represents the divine power of creation, strength, and authority. In Indian art and literature, sun gods such as Surya, Ravi, and Surya Devare are highly revered deities and have a profound impact on Hindu culture and mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Hemraaj holds immense significance in Hindu belief. The sun symbolizes wisdom, enlightenment, and purification. The name Hemraaj can inspire the child to strive for wisdom, strength, and leadership in their personal and spiritual growth. The name also carries the blessings of the sun god, promising abundance, prosperity, and protection. Ultimately, Hemraaj is a powerful and inspiring name that reflects the divine power and significance of the sun in Hindu tradition and spirituality.
